name: Engine Issues & Diagnostics
disclaimer: Automotive engines are complex systems. AI triage provides advisory context only and does not replace hands-on certified mechanical inspection.

subtopics.criticalWarning: A FLASHING Check Engine Light indicates an active severe misfire that can destroy the catalytic converter or cause catastrophic engine failure. Stop driving as soon as safely possible.
triageQuestions: Is the Check Engine light steady or flashing?
Do you notice any rough idling, shuddering, or loss of power?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Perform full OBD-II computer diagnostic scan at service center.

subtopics.criticalWarning: Continuing to drive under heavy misfire can cause fuel unburnt ignition in exhaust and overheat catalytic converter.
triageQuestions: Does the shaking happen only at idle or while driving at speed?
When were spark plugs or fuel filters last replaced?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Book a comprehensive ignition and fuel system diagnostic.

subtopics.criticalWarning: Engine stalling while driving cuts power steering and brake booster assist. Extreme road hazard.
triageQuestions: Does it stall when coming to a stop or while cruising?
Can you immediately restart the vehicle?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Recommend towing if vehicle stalls unpredictably on public roads.

triageRules: Never guess the exact internal failure without diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs).
Advise customer whether vehicle is safely drivable or needs towing.
